sources.entry: Preview3MF - Quick Look extension that shows a 3D preview and Finder thumbnails for .3mf 3D-printing files.

summary.one_liner: A macOS Quick Look extension that shows an interactive 3D preview and Finder thumbnails for .3mf 3D-printing files without needing a slicer.
use_cases: Preview .3mf print files in Finder with Space
See rendered icons for 3mf files in Finder
Inspect Bambu Studio or OrcaSlicer projects before printing
Check triangle count, dimensions and object count of a 3mf model
View multi-plate slicer projects plate by plate
Review print profile and estimated print time from a sliced project
how_to_run: Move Preview3MF.app to /Applications and launch it once
Enable both PreviewExtension and ThumbnailExtension in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Extensions → Quick Look
Run qlmanage -r if Quick Look does not pick it up
notable: Build plate sized from Bambu Studio / OrcaSlicer printable area, with turntable rotation
Reuses slicer-embedded preview PNG for fast Finder thumbnails, falling back to SceneKit rendering
Resolves 3MF assembly references and composed build transforms
Renders per-object and per-triangle colors from both slicer metadata and the 3MF Materials extension
Signed updates verified with EdDSA via Sparkle
caveats: Requires macOS 13+ and Xcode 15+ to build from source
Left/right arrow plate paging works only in the app window, not in Quick Look
Local builds cannot check for updates without a manual signing script
Versions v1.0.17 and earlier need a manual download to reach the Sparkle-based update system
